en.name: Alexander IV
en.summary: A pope who continued the papacy's campaign against the remaining Hohenstaufen claimants while facing a resurgent Mongol threat in the East.
en.body: Alexander IV pursued continued war against Manfred, the illegitimate son of Frederick II who had seized control of the Kingdom of Sicily against papal wishes, though with limited success during his reign. He also received alarming reports of Mongol advances into Eastern Europe and the Near East, prompting renewed but largely unsuccessful papal efforts to organize a coordinated Christian response.
